encode_text_prompt: encode text prompts into T5 text embeddings with attention masks for LTX video generation
encode_image_latents: encode input images into normalized latent space using the LTX VAE encoder for image-to-video generation
run_text_encoder_step: run the LTX text encoder pipeline step to generate prompt and negative prompt embeddings
run_vae_encoder_step: run the LTX VAE encoder pipeline step to encode images into latent representations
retrieve_encoder_latents: retrieve latents from VAE encoder output using sample or argmax mode
